newsitem.title: USA: First Commercial, Southwest to merge.
newsitem.headline: First Commercial, Southwest to merge.

text.p: First Commercial Corp said Friday it had reached a definitive agreement with Southwest Bancshares Inc to merge in a deal worth about $127.5 million.
"The affiliation will be executed through an exchange of approximately 3.4 million shares of (First Commercial) common stock for all of the outstanding shares of Southwest," it said.
First Commercial is a $5.4 billion bank holding company based in Little Rock and Southwest is a holding company headquartered in Jonesboro, Arkansas with combined assets of $812 million.
